title: Hyrum must obtain the word before he declares it
setting: Hyrum Smith, Joseph Smith’s older brother, came to Harmony, Pennsylvania, in May 1829 to learn about the work. Joseph inquired through the Urim and Thummim and received this revelation for him. Joseph’s history places it after the restoration of the Aaronic Priesthood, which he dated to 15 May 1829. Joseph Smith Papers notes suggest it came after Samuel Smith’s baptism, perhaps on 25 May. The pages of Revelation Book 1 that held it are missing.
summary: The revelation opens with the same call to the harvest given to Oliver Cowdery in section 6. It tells Hyrum to seek wisdom, not riches, and to say nothing but repentance. It says he will have a gift if he asks in faith with an honest heart. It tells him to trust the Spirit that leads to do good, do justly, walk humbly, and judge righteously. That Spirit will enlighten his mind and fill his soul with joy. He is not to preach until he is called. First he must obtain the word, studying what has gone forth and what is now being translated. Speaking as Jesus Christ, the voice promises power to become sons of God to all who receive him.

contextNote.title: Why Hyrum had to wait
contextNote.text: Verse 15 suggests Hyrum was ready to preach, and it tells him not to suppose he is called yet. Verse 21 gives the order: “first seek to obtain my word,” and only then declare it. Then his tongue will be loosed, and he will have the Spirit and power to convince. Verse 22 explains what obtaining means: studying the word already given and the record “now translating” at Harmony. Verse 26 asks him to treasure these things until the time comes. In this section, obtaining the word is study that comes before preaching.

ldsText: The 2025 Come, Follow Me lesson for sections 10–11 teaches that as we seek to obtain God’s word, we receive his Spirit and power. According to verse 22, which two bodies of the Lord’s word was Hyrum told to study?
reviewNote: Read all 30 verses. Official heading gives Harmony, May 1829, to Hyrum Smith through the Urim and Thummim at Joseph’s request, after the Aaronic Priesthood restoration. The JSP page loaded only the historical introduction’s footnotes; these support a date after Samuel Smith’s baptism (a later insertion gives 25 May) and note the missing Revelation Book 1 pages. Hyrum’s coming to Harmony to inquire is from Joseph Smith’s 1838–39 history as I recall it, not from text I loaded; please verify. The 15 May priesthood date is from Joseph’s history. Fact-check 2026-10-12: no changes. JSP introduction confirms Hyrum came to Harmony to inquire after Samuel’s baptism (later insertion gives 25 May) and Joseph inquired through the Urim and Thummim.
